name: Cold Justice

tenures.source: Won the vacant OWF Cincinnati Tag Team Championship from the Gospel Preachers at the promotion's own Christmas Carnage pay-per-view; billed defending it in a four-team match at the promotion's own closing SnowScraps: Termination card, whose own results do not survive.

caption: A tag team who won the OWF Cincinnati Tag Team Championship at the promotion's own first pay-per-view and were still billed defending it when the promotion closed for the winter.
